parts.title: Work and office

parts.title: School and study
parts.about: Classes and tests, languages and accents, maths homework, online courses, the library, school problems and research.

parts.title: Health and the doctor
parts.about: Being ill and getting better: the doctor and the dentist, checkups, healthy habits, stress, emergencies and talking openly about the body.

parts.title: Sport

chapters.title: Nice to Meet You
chapters.story: It is Anna's first week at [[college]] in Kyiv. Tonight there is a [[party]] for new [[students|student]]. A man says, "[[Ladies|lady]] and [[gentlemen|gentleman]], [[welcome]]!" Many [[people]] smile and clap. Anna sees a tall boy alone. She says, "[[Hello|hello]]! I am Anna." He says, "I am Max. [[Nice|nice]] to meet you!" They dance and laugh all night. The music is [[cool]], and the food is [[good]]. At the end, Anna and Max are [[friends|friend]].

chapters.title: Lost on the First Day
chapters.story: Anna is late on her first day. At the door, she is in [[trouble]]. A guard says, "Your [[ID]], [[please]]." Anna opens her bag and says, "[[Sorry|sorry]], [[sir]]. One [[moment]]." Then she cannot find room twelve. She asks a woman at the desk, "Excuse me, [[Miss]], where is it?" The woman smiles. "It is [[easy]]. Go up and left." Anna says, "[[OK]], thank you!" She gets to class just in time.

chapters.title: Tell Me About Yourself
chapters.story: After class, Anna and Max sit in the park. Anna asks Max about his [[background]]. He is from Odesa and is still a [[teenager]]. Anna's dad has a small [[business]], a flower shop. Max's [[hobby]] is taking pictures. Winter is Anna's favorite [[season]]. "What [[type]] of music do you like?" asks Max. "Rock! I am a big [[fan]]," says Anna. She likes his [[character]], because he is so [[friendly]]. They swap phone numbers to stay in [[contact]]. Then Max says, "[[Goodbye|goodbye]]! See you tomorrow!"

chapters.title: Anna's Photos
chapters.story: Anna shows Max her [[photos|photo]] on her phone. The first one is a [[selfie]] at the river. "Who is this?" asks Max. "This is my [[boyfriend]], Oleh." He is six [[feet|foot]] tall, with a kind [[face]]. Next is a girl with long [[blonde]] [[hair]]. That is Anna's cousin Olya. The last picture shows Dima, her [[crazy]] friend. He is always in a good [[mood]]. Max laughs. "Can I meet them all?"

chapters.title: A Plan for the Weekend
chapters.story: Max has an [[idea]] for the [[weekend]]. "Can you keep a [[secret]]?" he asks Anna. "My [[bro]] can give us his car. We have a [[chance]] to go to Lviv!" Anna smiles. "That is a [[super]] [[plan]]!" It makes [[sense]], because the train is expensive. They talk about the [[details|detail]] over tea. Who drives? Where do they sleep? Now it is a [[fact]]: they leave on Saturday!

chapters.title: Lunch at the Cafe
chapters.story: Anna and Max have [[lunch]] at a small [[cafe]]. It is near their college. They read the [[menu]]. Max orders [[soup]] and a [[sandwich]]. Anna wants a salad with [[dressing]]. She also takes chicken with [[rice]] and [[sauce]]. The food is hot and very tasty. For [[dessert]], Anna has cake and [[lemon]] tea. Max eats half of her cake!

chapters.title: Coffee Before Class
chapters.story: Max meets Anna at a [[coffee shop]] before class. The place has a great [[vibe]]. It is full of [[hipsters|hipster]] with laptops. The [[barista]] makes Anna a [[latte]]. It is from a new [[blend]]. Max orders a [[cappuccino]] with [[caramel]]. He tastes it slowly and nods. Anna laughs. "You are a real coffee [[snob]]!" They also take a [[croissant]] and a [[muffin]]. Then they run to class, cups in hand.

chapters.title: Pizza Night
chapters.story: On Friday, Max wants to [[chill]] at home. Anna and two friends come over. They order a big [[pizza]] for [[delivery]]. "What [[topping]] do we want?" asks Anna. "[[Pepperoni|pepperoni]] and [[mozzarella]]!" says Max. It is huge, with a [[diameter]] of forty centimeters. They also get [[cola]], [[nachos]], and other [[snacks|snack]]. Then Max makes [[popcorn]], and they watch a movie. Soon everybody is asleep on the sofa.

chapters.title: At the Burger Place
chapters.story: After the cinema, Max wants [[fast food]]. They walk to a small place near the park. Cars wait in line at the [[drive-through]]. But Anna, Max, and his cousin Ihor go inside. Max orders a [[burger]] with [[ketchup]] and [[mayonnaise]]. He also gets a chocolate [[milkshake]]. Anna takes a small [[sundae]]. Ihor is older, so he orders a cold [[lager]]. They eat and talk about the movie. Max has sauce on his nose, and they laugh.

chapters.title: Sunday Breakfast
chapters.story: On Sunday morning, Anna's mama made a big breakfast. She put bread in the [[toaster]]. Soon there was hot [[toast]] with [[jam]] on the table. Next came [[pancakes|pancake]] with sweet [[syrup]]. Dad cooked [[bacon]] and a cheese [[omelet]]. Anna ate everything and felt very happy. Only her brother Taras was on a diet. He ate just [[yogurt]] and half a [[grapefruit]]. But ten minutes later, his plate was full!

chapters.title: At the Supermarket
chapters.story: Anna and Max go to the [[supermarket]]. Friends come for dinner tonight. First, they take a [[kilo]] of tomatoes. Then they get two [[liters|liter]] of milk. Max puts [[broccoli]] and an [[avocado]] in the cart. They also take a sweet [[mango]] and four [[kiwis|kiwi]]. Anna loves [[citrus]] fruit, so she adds [[tangerines|tangerine]]. For snacks, they get [[cheddar]], [[salami]], and [[crackers|cracker]]. At the checkout, Max looks at the bill. It is a big dinner!

chapters.title: Cooking for a Vegan Friend
chapters.story: Anna invited her friend Lisa for dinner. Lisa is a [[vegan]], and she can't eat [[gluten]]. So Anna decided to cook [[tofu]] in a big [[wok]]. She added [[kale]] and [[zucchini]] too. Then she made a [[curry]] with one hot [[chili]]. She also made some [[hummus]] with fresh carrots. Lisa arrived, and they sat down to eat. Suddenly, Lisa smelled something strange. Anna forgot to turn off the [[gas]]! She ran to the kitchen and turned it off. Dinner was almost a [[fiasco]], but the food was great.

chapters.title: Baking for Grandma
chapters.story: Anna and her mom bake for Grandma's birthday. First they put all the [[ingredients|ingredient]] on the table. Anna weighs two hundred [[grams|gram]] of flour. They have no sugar, so honey is their [[substitute]]. Mom adds [[cinnamon]] and a spoon of vanilla [[extract]]. Anna turns on the [[mixer]], and Mom sets the [[timer]]. Soon twelve [[cupcakes|cupcake]] come out of the oven. Anna puts pink [[icing]] on each one. Then they make a [[cheesecake]] and a tray of [[brownies|brownie]]. Mom bakes an apple [[tart]], and Anna makes chocolate [[fudge]] with [[pecans|pecan]]. Last, they make Grandma's favorite [[red velvet]] cake. In the evening, Grandma tries everything and smiles.

chapters.title: A barbecue at the dacha
chapters.story: On Saturday Anna's family has a [[barbecue]] at the dacha. Dad connects the [[propane]] tank carefully. He checks the [[regulator]] twice. Then he cooks [[hamburgers|hamburger]] and [[hot dogs|hot dog]] for everyone. Later he puts a big piece of [[roast beef]] on the [[grill]]. After a day in the garden, everyone has a huge [[appetite]]. The kids drink cold [[lemonade]] in the shade. In the evening they roast [[marshmallows|marshmallow]] over the fire. Nobody wants to go back to the city.

chapters.title: Dinner at an Italian restaurant
chapters.story: Max takes Anna to an Italian restaurant for her birthday. The [[hostess]] smiles and shows them to a table by the window. Max orders a glass of [[pinot]], and Anna asks for water. Max chooses [[spaghetti]], and Anna wants [[ravioli]]. The chef makes all the [[pasta]] by hand. They also share a [[risotto]] with [[parmesan]] and black [[truffle]]. For dessert, they have chocolate [[mousse]]. Max drinks an [[espresso]] and pays the bill. "Best birthday ever," says Anna.

chapters.title: Mom's comfort food
chapters.story: After a hard week, Anna goes home to her parents. She arrives just as Mom takes dinner out of the oven. "Perfect [[timing]]!" says Mom. Tonight it's all Anna's favorite [[comfort food]]. They eat outside on the [[patio]]. There is hot [[lasagna]] and a bowl of [[mac and cheese]]. Dad loves the pasta [[alfredo]] most. Grandma's apple pie is made with [[lard]], like in the old days. For dessert there is chocolate [[pudding]] and cherry jelly with [[gelatin]]. Dad drinks a little [[brandy]] after dinner. Mom puts the rest of the food in Anna's [[lunch box]].

chapters.title: Street food Saturday
chapters.story: Anna and Max walk to a [[food market]] by the river. They want to try some [[street food]]. Max buys a big [[kebab]] first. Anna gets two [[tacos|taco]] and a [[burrito]] from a [[food truck]]. The cook makes warm [[tortillas|tortilla]] right in front of them. They also buy chips with [[guacamole]] and a spicy cheese [[dip]]. Max's face turns red, and he drinks a whole bottle of water. "Too hot for you?" Anna laughs.

chapters.title: Happy hour
chapters.story: After a long week, Max's new colleagues invite him to [[happy hour]]. They meet at a small [[bar]], and Anna comes too. The [[bartender]] is fast and friendly. He makes [[cocktails|cocktail]] for everyone. Oleh orders a [[martini]]. Max asks for a [[gin]] and [[tonic]] with [[lime]]. Iryna drinks a [[lite]] beer. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she orders orange juice. By the end of the evening, Max knows everyone's name.

chapters.title: Quiz night at the pub
chapters.story: Every Thursday there is a [[quiz]] at an Irish [[pub]] in town. Anna, Max and their friends make a team. The [[barman]] brings [[ale]] and [[cider]] from a new [[keg]]. Anna drinks tea and answers all the history questions. Between rounds, they play [[darts]]. Max misses the board every time. Then he plays [[snooker]] and wins easily. At the end, their team gets second place and a free pizza.

chapters.title: A new sweater
chapters.story: Anna loves [[shopping]]. Today she goes to a big [[shopping center]]. She needs a warm [[sweater]] for winter. In a shop window, she sees a [[mannequin]]. It wears a nice red one. It is on [[sale]]! Anna asks for the same [[model]] in blue. It is soft [[cotton]], not [[nylon]] or [[polyester]]. She also gets a student [[discount]]. She pays in [[cash]] and smiles.

chapters.title: Max needs a new look
chapters.story: Max wants a new [[style]], but he knows nothing about [[fashion]]. So Anna takes him to a small [[boutique]] in the city center. A shop assistant comes up to them. "Can I help you, [[madam]]?" she asks Anna. "Yes, my friend needs a new [[outfit]]," Anna says. First she chooses a gray [[hoodie]] from a good [[brand]]. Then she finds a [[denim]] jacket and [[baggy]] jeans. She also adds a white [[tank top]] and a green [[beanie]]. Max looks in the mirror and smiles. "Maybe I need a [[tattoo]] now," he says. "And a [[piercing]]?" Anna laughs. "One step at a time!"

chapters.title: At the beauty salon
chapters.story: Anna has a big party on Saturday. In the morning, she goes to a beauty [[salon]]. Her [[stylist]], Olena, is very kind. She does the [[styling]] with a little hair [[gel]]. Then Anna gets a [[manicure]]. After that, a nice hand [[cream]] makes her skin soft. At home, Anna does her [[makeup]] with [[mascara]] and [[eyeliner]]. Next door to the salon, Max goes to the [[barber]]. He sits next to a man with a big [[afro]]. At the party, Anna and Max both look great.

chapters.title: A present for Mom
chapters.story: Anna and her brother Taras need a birthday present for Mom. They go to a small jewelry shop. First they look at white [[pearls|pearl]]. Then Taras finds a silver [[bracelet]] and a gold [[medallion]]. There are rings with a [[sapphire]], an [[opal]] and an [[amethyst]]. Everything is very expensive! An [[expert]] in the shop is very helpful. He explains what a [[carat]] is. Then he shows them a beautiful [[crystal]] on a thin chain. It is pretty and not expensive, so they buy it. Mom loves her present.

chapters.title: Anna's student budget
chapters.story: Today Anna counts her money. Her parents send her a hundred [[dollars|dollar]]. She has 50 more: 100 [[plus]] 50 is 150. Books cost 40, and 150 [[minus]] 40 is 110. Anna is on a tight [[budget]]. She saves every [[cent]] and every [[penny]]. On Monday she goes to the [[bank]]. She checks her [[balance]] and makes a [[deposit]]. Anna wants a new phone. But she does not buy it on [[credit]]. She saves for it instead.

chapters.title: A parcel for Max
chapters.story: Max loves [[online shopping]]. One evening he opens his favorite [[site]]. He finds great headphones in its [[catalog]]. He uses a [[coupon]] and saves ten dollars. Every day he checks the [[status]] of his order. On Friday a [[courier]] brings the box to his door. But the [[product]] does not look right. The left side is very quiet, so it has a [[defect]]. "This is a [[fake]]!" Max tells Anna. He sends it back and gets his money back. Then he buys real headphones from a good seller on a [[marketplace]].

chapters.title: Sofia's first fashion show
chapters.story: Max's sister Sofia is studying to be a [[fashion designer]]. On Saturday she shows her first collection at a small [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. It isn't real [[couture]], but every piece is made by hand. A tall [[supermodel]] opens the show in a black [[corset]] and a long red [[cape]]. Next come soft jackets in [[cashmere]], [[tweed]] and [[flannel]]. The last model, dressed like a [[dandy]], wears a smart suit in [[khaki]]. After the show, Anna asks Sofia why she never uses nylon or polyester. Sofia smiles. "Natural [[material]] like wool feels better on the skin." "And good [[textiles|textile]] last for years," she adds. Her teacher says it is the best collection in the class.

chapters.title: Around Kyiv by metro
chapters.story: Anna's cousin Taras is her [[visitor]] today. It is his first [[visit]] to Kyiv. Kyiv has three [[million]] people. Anna loves public [[transport]], so they take the [[metro]]. An [[inspector]] checks their tickets. The [[escalator]] takes them up to the [[center]]. They walk down the [[avenue]] to the [[park]]. Taras takes photos of a big [[monument]]. "Excuse me, [[mister]], your wallet!" a woman calls. Taras says thank you. Then they ask a [[policeman]] the way home.

chapters.title: Taxi to the airport
chapters.story: Anna flies to London today. Max helps her with her [[stuff]]. They put two bags in a [[taxi]]. The driver turns on the [[GPS]]. He takes the [[highway]] to the airport. It is forty [[kilometers|kilometer]] away. "Thirty minutes [[max]]," he says. Soon they stop at the [[terminal]]. Free [[shuttle]] buses wait next to it. Anna hugs Max and runs inside.

chapters.title: Anna's first flight
chapters.story: Anna's first flight starts with [[chaos]] at the airport. Her [[baggage]] weighs twenty [[kilograms|kilogram]], just right. She shows her [[passport]] and [[visa]] to the officer. Border [[control]] is quick and easy. At the [[duty-free]] she buys chocolate for her friends. Then she sees a [[celebrity]] going into [[business class]]! On the [[aeroplane]], a friendly [[steward]] brings her coffee. She changes planes at a big [[hub]] in Europe. But her bag gets lost in [[transit]]. Her power [[converter]] is in that bag too! In London she has bad [[jet lag]] and no charger. The next day the bag arrives, and Anna laughs.

chapters.title: A hotel for the weekend
chapters.story: Max finds a cheap [[hotel]] in Lviv. He makes a [[booking]] for the weekend. The room is for four people [[maximum]]. There is a fee for a [[no-show]]. On Friday, Max and Anna go to [[reception]]. The [[check-in]] is very quick. The woman gives them the [[Wi-Fi]] password. Their room is at the end of the [[corridor]]. It is small, not [[deluxe]], but nice. Max needs a phone [[adapter]], and they have one. [[Check-out|check-out]] is at eleven on Sunday. Max and Anna love their weekend.

chapters.title: A night of luxury
chapters.story: Anna wins a night in a [[luxury]] hotel in a radio competition. A smiling [[concierge]] meets her in the [[foyer]]. Her room has a [[king-size]] bed and a [[jacuzzi]]. In the evening she tries the [[spa]]. First she gets a back [[massage]], then she relaxes in the [[sauna]]. In the morning she orders breakfast from [[room service]]. She sends Max a photo: "I never want to go home!"

chapters.title: Max's new scooter
chapters.story: Max buys an electric [[scooter]] to get to college faster. On Monday he rides on the smooth [[asphalt]] by the river. A [[biker]] on a loud motorcycle passes him. Max goes faster and forgets the speed [[limit]]. In a dark [[tunnel]] he almost hits a [[bicycle]]. Luckily, he sees its red [[reflector]] just in time. The cyclist stops, her foot still on the [[pedal]]. "Slow down!" she shouts. After this [[incident]], Max always rides slowly.

chapters.title: Dad buys a car
chapters.story: Anna's dad is a car [[enthusiast]]. He watches every [[grand prix]] on TV. Now he wants a new [[automobile]] for the family. On Saturday Anna and Dad go to a car [[dealer]]. In the big [[showroom]], Dad stops next to a red [[supercar]]. Then he looks at a long white [[limousine]]. "Too expensive, Dad," Anna laughs. So he chooses between a [[sedan]] and a [[diesel]] [[minivan]]. Anna's driving [[instructor]] comes too and gives good advice. Dad takes the minivan for a [[test drive]]. Then he asks the manager about [[leasing]]. Next week the family drives home in a new car.

chapters.title: The car breaks down
chapters.story: On the way to the dacha, Dad presses the [[accelerator]]. But the car slows down, and the [[motor]] stops. Anna calls a [[mechanic]] from a small [[auto]] repair shop. He comes quickly and takes the car to his [[garage]]. There he uses a very loud air [[compressor]]. He cleans the [[carburetor]], and the car starts again. He also checks the [[chassis]], and it is fine. Then he finds a crack in the [[bumper]] and fixes it. Dad pays, and the family gets to the dacha for dinner.

chapters.title: A road trip in America
chapters.story: Max and his cousin Ivan go on a [[road trip]] in America. Uncle Petro drives a [[camper]], and the boys have an old [[jeep]]. It has a [[turbo]], so it is fast. They take an [[off-road]] path into the hills. Max's phone sits in a [[holder]] and shows the map. At a gas station, gas costs four dollars a [[gallon]]. In the evening they follow a [[pickup]] to a cheap [[motel]]. Each boy eats a huge [[cheeseburger]]. Uncle Petro tries a [[bourbon]] and makes a funny face. Everyone sleeps well after a long day.

chapters.title: Planning a summer trip
chapters.story: Anna and Max want a [[trip]] in August. They go to a travel [[bureau]] in Kyiv. An [[agent]] meets them with a smile. She works for a big [[tour operator]]. She shows them a [[low-cost]] flight. This plane flies [[nonstop]] to the coast. A [[charter]] is cheap too. Or they take a bus [[tour]] with a [[guide]]. "[[Tourism|tourism]] is very big this year," she says. "Every [[tourist]] wants to go to the sea." Max has a [[voucher]] from his mom. They book two bus seats and smile.

chapters.title: Uncle Ivan, the Pilot
chapters.story: Max's Uncle Ivan is a [[pilot]]. One Saturday he took Max and Anna to the airport. They sat in the [[cockpit]] of his big [[jet]]. "Here is the [[radar]], and here is the [[transponder]]," he said. Anna asked, "Does the [[autopilot]] fly the plane for you?" Then they drove to a small airfield. A [[helicopter]] landed there, and its [[rotor]] was very loud. Next to it stood an old plane with a [[propeller]]. "My old teacher flies that [[glider]]," said Uncle Ivan. "He is a real [[ace]]." Then a man jumped from a plane with a red [[parachute]]. That evening Max practiced on a flight [[simulator]] for hours.

chapters.title: Anna's New Smartphone
chapters.story: Anna's old phone broke, so she went shopping with Max. She wanted a [[high-end]] [[smartphone]] this time. "This one has a very fast [[chip]]," the shop assistant said. He showed her the [[camera]] and its strong [[zoom]]. Anna touched the big [[touchscreen]], and the [[display]] was bright and clear. Her finger on the [[sensor]] opened the phone at once. The assistant connected her headphones by [[Bluetooth]]. He also changed her [[ringtone]] to a happy song. "It's an expensive [[device]]," Anna said quietly. "But it's the best [[gadget]] in the shop," Max said. Anna smiled and bought it.

chapters.title: No Signal in the Metro
chapters.story: Anna is in the metro. Her phone has no [[signal]]. There is no [[internet]] here. She cannot go [[online]]. Anna is [[offline]] for an hour. Then she walks up to the street. Her phone gets twenty [[messages|message]]. There is an [[alert]] from the group [[chat]]. Then Mama calls: "Why is your [[roaming]] on?" Anna laughs and turns it off.

chapters.title: Max Fixes the Laptop
chapters.story: Anna's [[laptop]] was slow and full of [[glitches|glitch]]. So she called Max, who works in [[IT]]. He connected it to his own [[computer]]. Soon he found the problem in the [[software]]. "First, let's make a [[backup]] of every [[file]]," he said. He saved them on a [[disk]] with a [[USB]] [[cable]]. Then he installed an [[update]] and did a [[reset]]. "Too many programs for one [[user]]!" Max joked. Then he showed her a keyboard [[shortcut]] for copying text. "It works like new now!" Anna said happily.

chapters.title: An Email to the Professor
chapters.story: Anna had to write her first [[email]] in English to a professor. She logged in to her [[account]] with her [[username]]. Then she chose a simple [[template]]. She put her name in the [[header]]. She put a [[slash]] between the day and the month. Then she attached her homework in PDF [[format]]. All evening she checked her [[inbox]], but nothing came. Max said, "Maybe his [[reply]] is in [[spam]]." He was right! The professor thanked her and sent a [[link]] to a reading list.

chapters.title: Train Tickets Online
chapters.story: Anna wanted train tickets to Lviv, so she tried an [[online service]]. The [[website]] opened very slowly in her [[browser]]. The [[layout]] was confusing, and she could not find the tickets. While [[browsing]], she closed three [[pop-ups|pop-up]]. Finally, with one [[click]], she bought tickets for her and Max. Then she entered the [[code]] from an [[SMS]]. She took a [[screenshot]] of the [[QR code]] for the trip. On the train, the conductor checked her phone. Anna showed him a [[scan]] of her student card too. Everything was fine, and the trip began.

chapters.title: Max's Home Office
chapters.story: Max's new flat had no internet. On Monday, a technician from his [[provider]] came. He brought a [[router]] and a [[modem]]. He fixed a bad [[connector]] and moved the [[antenna]] on the roof. Then Max made a small [[home office]] in his bedroom. His new [[setup]] had a big [[monitor]] and a [[headset]]. It also had a good [[microphone]] for video calls. He bought an old [[printer]], but it needed a new [[cartridge]]. Anna brought him her old [[scanner]] as a housewarming gift. "Now I can work from home!" Max said happily.

chapters.title: Anna's Family Tree
chapters.story: Anna draws her family tree for Max. Her parents and two [[siblings|sibling]] are on it. Aunt Olha is in her last [[trimester]]. The [[placenta]] and the [[baby]] are healthy. Soon Anna has a new [[cousin]]! "Your [[clan]] is very big!" Max says. Grandpa is an old [[admiral]], now a [[pensioner]]. He still has an old [[telephone]] at home. [[Mama|mama]] is a [[millennial]], and Grandpa is a [[boomer]]. Grandpa is an [[optimist]], but Grandma is a [[realist]]. "You have his [[genes|gene]]," Max laughs.

chapters.title: A Surprise for Mama
chapters.story: Anna and her brother Taras planned a [[surprise]] party for Mama's birthday. They sent an [[invite]] to the whole family. Taras ordered a big [[bouquet]] from a [[florist]] near their home. When Mama came home, everyone shouted and threw [[confetti]]. Anna gave her a [[scrapbook]] of old family photos. Mama cried happy tears. Her friend Lida brought a cake with coffee [[liqueur]]. Then they all sang [[karaoke]] until late. Then Mama paid her kids a sweet [[compliment]]: "You are the best!"

chapters.title: Max Finds a Flat
chapters.story: Max wanted to move out of his parents' home. A [[realtor]] showed him a [[townhouse]], but it was too expensive. Then she showed him a small [[loft]] in an old building. The [[interior]] of the building was very modern. An old [[sofa]] stood in the [[hall]] downstairs. Upstairs, the [[decor]] was simple and nice. There was a [[mini]] fridge and a [[queen-size]] bed. Max tested the [[intercom]] and the [[thermostat]]. The room was only four [[meters|meter]] wide. But Max loved the [[comfort]] of the place. "I'll take it!" he said.

chapters.title: Fixing Things at Home
chapters.story: Anna's dad and Taras did not want to call a [[professional]]. "We can fix the flat ourselves," Dad said. First, Taras used a [[drill]] to make holes for [[metal]] shelves. They used [[bolts|bolt]] five [[millimeters|millimeter]] wide. Then Dad repaired the [[mechanism]] in the door lock. He also checked the electrical [[panel]]. They built a small wall with concrete [[blocks|block]] and [[cement]]. Next, they painted it with [[primer]]. Their neighbor used a strong [[adhesive]] for his [[siding]]. He also had a loud concrete [[vibrator]] for his new steps. Dad laughed, "Next time, we'll ask him for help!"

chapters.title: A Winter Blackout
chapters.story: One cold January evening, there was a [[blackout]] in Anna's building. Dad turned on the [[generator]] in the yard. It gave a loud [[beep]] and started working. Mama lit an old [[kerosene]] lamp. Anna wrapped herself in Grandma's warm [[quilt]]. Slowly the [[boiler]] and the [[radiator]] got cold. Suddenly the smoke [[detector]] went off because of the lamp! Taras opened the window for a minute. "Don't worry, nobody will get [[hypothermia]] tonight," Mama joked. At midnight the lights came back on.

chapters.title: Cleaning day
chapters.story: On Saturday, Max's flat is a big mess. He calls a [[cleaner]] and turns on his little [[robot]]. The cleaner, Oksana, puts all the [[plastic]] in the [[recycling]] bin. Old food goes into the [[compost]] on the balcony. She puts the leftovers in a [[container]] in the fridge. Max chooses a short [[cycle]] but adds too much [[detergent]]. Soon there are bubbles all over the bathroom floor! Oksana laughs and fills the soap [[dispenser]] with the extra soap. She changes the coffee [[filter]] and uses a window [[spray]]. Max tests the fire [[alarm]], and it beeps loudly. In the evening, the flat is clean and smells nice.

chapters.title: A weekend at the dacha
chapters.story: Anna and Max visit Grandma's [[cottage]] at the dacha. They drink tea on the [[veranda]], and Max sleeps in the [[hammock]]. A funny garden [[gnome]] stands next to the door. In the morning, Grandma goes to the [[garden center]] for seeds. She also buys [[insecticide]] for the bugs on her [[dahlias|dahlia]]. Anna helps her plant a purple [[iris]] and a pink [[azalea]]. In the evening, the [[jasmine]] and the [[magnolia]] smell sweet. Then Anna turns on the [[sprinkler]] and gets Max all wet! He laughs and says, "Now I am a flower too!"

chapters.title: Taras wants a pet
chapters.story: Anna's little brother Taras really wants a pet. On Sunday, Anna takes him to the [[pet shop]]. First they look at a big [[aquarium]] with orange [[koi]]. Taras loves the green [[iguana]], but Anna says it is too big. Then they see three little dogs. The [[chihuahua]] is tiny, and the [[terrier]] barks at everyone. The white [[poodle]] is calm and quiet. The seller says, "This one already has a [[microchip]]." She also says it has a gentle [[temperament]] and loves children. Taras smiles and asks, "Can we come back with Mom?"

chapters.title: Games night at Grandma's
chapters.story: On Friday, the family has a games night at Grandma's. Anna and Max start a big [[puzzle]] on the table. Grandpa does a [[crossword]] and asks everyone for help. Then they play [[bingo]], and Mom wins a chocolate bar. Grandma teaches Max how to play [[mahjong]]. Later Anna and Max play [[ping-pong]] in the basement. In the card game, Grandpa has the [[joker]] again! Then he plays chess with Max and starts with a clever [[gambit]]. Max fights hard, but Grandpa wins the [[endgame]]. At the end, Grandma reads [[tarot]] cards and everyone's [[horoscope]]. She says, "Max will win next Friday!"

chapters.title: Anna the babysitter
chapters.story: On Saturday, Anna is the [[babysitter]] for the neighbors' kids. Lev is eight, and Mila is five. Anna has a list of fun [[activities|activity]] for the day. First Lev dresses up as a [[pirate]], and Mila is an [[angel]]. They play a game about a scary [[monster]] and a slow [[zombie]]. Mila gets scared, so they make cards with [[stickers|sticker]] and [[glitter]]. After lunch, they go to the park and ride the [[carousel]]. Nearby, a [[clown]] gives free rides on a [[pony]]. At home, they make a [[collage]] about their day. Then Lev's big brother comes home in his [[boy scout]] uniform. The kids ask him, "Can Anna come again next Saturday?"

chapters.title: Max on a dating app
chapters.story: Max is single, so he tries a [[dating]] app. Anna helps him with his [[profile]] and his photo. Max asks, "Do I look [[sexy]] here?" Anna laughs and says, "Write about your hobbies, not about [[sex]]." Then Max sees his [[ex]], a real [[narcissist]], on the app. "She never listened to you. That was a [[red flag]]," Anna says. Suddenly Max gets a message from Lina, his [[crush]] from the gym! She studies history and invites him to a [[rendezvous]] at the museum. She shows him a [[fetish]], a holy wooden object from long ago. Max smiles: maybe this is the start of a [[love story]].

chapters.title: Sofia's coming out
chapters.story: On Sunday, Max's sister Sofia invites the whole family for dinner. She is nervous, because this dinner is her [[coming out]]. "I am [[queer]]," she says, "and I want you to meet my [[partner]], Dana." For a moment the room is quiet, and then Max gives his sister a big hug. Grandma asks many questions, and Dana kindly explains [[gender]] and what [[LGBT]] means. Dad admits that he believed an old [[stereotype]] from TV. Mom says that in her family, talking about feelings was always a [[taboo]]. "Not in this family," Grandma says, and she pours tea for Dana first. Max raises his glass: "To Sofia and Dana, with love and [[respect]]!"

chapters.title: Cousin Olya's wedding
chapters.story: Anna's cousin Olya gets married on Saturday. An event [[coordinator]] plans everything for the big day. The [[banquet]] is in a beautiful old hotel. The [[catering]] is excellent, and the cake is huge. Olya wears a white dress and a small silver [[tiara]]. Max films everything with his dad's old [[video camera]]. The groom's friend Ian is from Scotland, and he wears a [[kilt]]. Ian makes a funny [[speech]]. Then he acts like a [[buffoon]] with a flower on his head! Later the [[DJ]] plays a slow [[waltz]] for the happy couple. Grandma says, "This is the best party since the new [[millennium]]!" Olya smiles: "I will remember this day [[forever]]."

chapters.title: Max's job interview
chapters.story: Max is a student, but he wants a [[part-time]] job. He dreams of becoming a [[software engineer]]. On Monday, a [[recruiter]] from an IT company calls him. On Wednesday, Max wears his new [[blazer]] to the interview. The [[interviewer]] is a friendly woman named Iryna. She asks about his [[skills|skill]] in coding. Then she asks about teamwork, an important [[soft skill]]. Max shows his [[portfolio]] with three small apps. He asks about every [[aspect]] of the job, like hours and pay. Two days later, Max gets an [[offer]]! On Friday, he reads the [[contract]] carefully and signs it.

chapters.title: Max's first day at work
chapters.story: It is Friday, Max's first day at the [[office]]. A woman from [[HR]] gives him a [[badge]]. He meets his [[boss]] and the [[office manager]]. Kate, the [[assistant]], tells him about the [[dress code]]. Max looks down at his old jeans. Kate laughs: "Jeans are OK on Fridays!" At ten, the [[training]] starts in the [[meeting room]]. But Max's computer does not work. The [[administrator]] comes and helps him fast. Max thinks, "I like this new job."

chapters.title: A new project
chapters.story: It is a busy [[period]] at Max's work. The team [[leader]], Olena, starts a new [[project]] for a big [[client]]. The [[manager]], Pavlo, gives Max his first [[task]] with a Friday [[deadline]]. Pavlo writes every [[milestone]] on the team [[wiki]]. Max also makes his own [[checklist]] with ten small steps. He works with great [[enthusiasm]]. He even sets three alarms for one meeting. Pavlo laughs: "Three alarms? That is [[overkill]]!" On Thursday, Max finishes everything early, and the client is happy.

chapters.title: Max's first presentation
chapters.story: On Monday, Max gives his first presentation to the client. He is nervous, and the [[projector]] does not turn on at first. Finally, his first [[slide]] appears on the wall. Max talks about a [[document]] on the client's new delivery [[service]]. The client listens carefully and asks many questions. The next day, she sends her [[feedback]] in a long email. Then her team sends a [[follow-up]] with some useful [[insights|insight]]. They like the [[impact]] of the work on their sales. They ask for a [[deep dive]] into the numbers next week. Max smiles: his first presentation was a success.

chapters.title: A one-on-one with the boss
chapters.story: Max has worked at the office for three months. Today he has a [[one-on-one]] meeting with Ms. Lee, his [[supervisor]]. It is his first [[performance review]], and he feels nervous. Ms. Lee smiles and talks about his [[progress]] on the new project. "You have real [[potential]]," she says. She also likes his [[professionalism]] with difficult clients. Then the [[director]] comes in with an envelope. Inside is a small [[bonus]] for Max! The good news gives him a big [[boost]]. That evening, he buys pizza for Anna and their friends.

chapters.title: Sofia works freelance
chapters.story: On Saturday, Max visits his sister Sofia and says, "Hey, [[sis]]!" Sofia is a [[freelancer]], and she works from home. Right now she is writing an [[invoice]] for a client. On the wall there is a big [[calendar]] with colorful notes. She plans her week in a [[task manager]] app too. "I read a lot about [[time management]]," she says. Last month she tried career [[coaching]] online. Her coach told her that [[networking]] brings new clients. "But do you ever rest?" Max asks. Sofia laughs and closes her laptop. "For me, [[work-life balance]] is important!"

chapters.title: A summer job at a call center
chapters.story: This summer Anna works at a [[call center]]. It belongs to a big [[telecom]] company. Every morning she reads her answers from a [[script]]. Difficult calls go to an [[operator]] with more experience. Questions about bills go to [[billing]]. Angry clients with broken phones go to the [[service center]]. One day Anna needs an old contract. A [[clerk]] named Mr. Bondar brings it from the [[back office]]. He still sends documents by [[fax]]! Anna laughs, and he laughs too. At lunch they buy snacks from the [[vending]] machine together.

chapters.title: A problem at work
chapters.story: One evening, Max's colleague Olena tells him about [[harassment]] by their manager, Mr. Shevchuk. Max faces a [[dilemma]]: he wants to help, but he is new on the team. He does not want an open [[conflict]], so he decides to act with [[tact]]. First, he reads the company [[guideline]] about [[compliance]] and workplace behavior. Then Olena and Max talk to the [[compliance officer]] together. She listens carefully and takes notes. A week later, the director gives Mr. Shevchuk an [[ultimatum]]: change or leave. He leaves, and his loyal [[lackey]], who always laughed at his jokes, leaves too. Now Olena feels safe at work again.

chapters.title: Big changes at the company
chapters.story: Anna's aunt Iryna works at a big delivery company. One day [[top management]] announces big changes. They write a [[business case]] for a new way of working. Every [[business process]] in the company must change. They also cut [[middle management]] to save [[resources|resource]]. Aunt Iryna has worked in [[management]] in this [[sector]] for fifteen years. She is not happy about the changes. At dinner, Anna asks about her [[motive]] for leaving the company. "I want to choose my own projects," Aunt Iryna explains. Leaving is a long [[process]], with many papers and meetings. But after two months, she starts [[freelance]] work from home, and she loves it.

chapters.title: Professor Brown's class
chapters.story: It is Anna's first [[class]] this [[semester]]. Her teacher is [[Professor|professor]] Brown. He has an [[old-school]] way of teaching. He gives everyone a paper [[syllabus]]. He writes on the board with a [[marker]]. "Patience is an important [[attribute]]," he says. Then he shows them the [[campus]]. They walk to the old [[institute]] building. Anna likes him a lot. She wants to be patient too.

chapters.title: Anna's English test
chapters.story: Anna takes an English [[course]] at the university. Today she has a big [[test]]. It takes a [[minimum]] of two hours. First, she reads a [[text]] and writes a [[dialogue]]. Then she writes an [[essay]] about Kyiv. She chooses the right [[adjective]] and a [[synonym]]. The [[context]] helps her find each Ukrainian [[equivalent]]. Later, the teacher shows her two small mistakes. She forgets a [[comma]] and a [[consonant]]. But she still gets a good grade!

chapters.title: Small talk with exchange students
chapters.story: Anna meets three exchange students from India, Ireland and Texas. Priya from India also speaks [[Hindi]]. At first, [[small talk]] is hard for Anna. There is a language [[barrier]], and everyone has a different [[accent]]. Liam from Ireland uses a lot of [[slang]]. Jake from Texas speaks a southern [[dialect]]. When Jake says "Great weather!" in the rain, it is [[sarcasm]]. Liam laughs and says "Time flies," a famous [[cliché]]. Priya writes "LOL" in the chat, and Anna learns a new [[acronym]]. Liam's cousin is "between jobs," a polite [[euphemism]] for no work. Anna understands that every word can carry a [[nuance]]. By the end of the evening, they are good friends.

chapters.title: Taras's math homework
chapters.story: Anna's little brother Taras has [[algebra]] homework from [[Mrs.]] Koval. He is sad because it looks very hard. Anna shows him an easy [[method]]. First, they take a [[calculator]] from the drawer. They use a [[formula]] with [[pi]]. With it, they find the [[radius]] of a circle. Next, they find the [[perimeter]] of a square. After that, Taras draws a [[cube]], a [[cylinder]] and an [[oval]]. "Math is fun with you!" he says. The next day, he gets a top grade.

chapters.title: Anna studies online
chapters.story: Anna is taking an [[online course]] in marketing. Her learning app shows a thirty-day [[streak]], and she is proud. Every evening she watches a video [[tutorial]]. Each [[module]] of the [[e-learning]] program has a short quiz. For hard topics, she books [[one-to-one]] lessons on the student [[portal]]. After six weeks, she gets a [[certificate]]! Her teacher says, "You should apply for a [[grant]]." Anna fills in the form that same night.

chapters.title: A day in the library
chapters.story: On Saturday, Anna spends the whole day in the old university library. First, she visits its [[archive]] in the basement. She finds a huge [[encyclopedia]] and an old [[atlas]] of the world. She also finds an old [[manuscript]] in [[Latin]]. Anna cannot read it, but she takes a picture. Later, she sits by the window with a [[paperback]]. It is [[fiction]], a mystery about a lost ship. The [[author]] writes under a [[pseudonym]]. In the [[prologue]], the writer explains how the story began. Anna reads until the library closes.

chapters.title: Trouble at Taras's school
chapters.story: Some older boys at school play a cruel [[prank]] on Taras. They hide his bag and laugh at him. They call him a [[geek]] and a [[loser]] for his high [[IQ]]. Then a [[hater]] writes mean comments about him online. The [[bullying]] really gets on his [[nerves|nerve]]. Soon Taras has a nervous [[tic]] in his eye. Anna talks to his teacher about the problem. The school gives Taras a [[mentor]], a kind older student named Dmytro. They talk every week, and Taras feels strong again.

chapters.title: Aunt Iryna's Doctorate
chapters.story: Anna's aunt Iryna finally finished her [[doctorate]] in sociology this fall. In October, Anna went with her to her [[alma mater]] in Lviv. The university held a big [[symposium]] there, and Iryna gave the opening talk. Her main [[argument]] was simple: public [[discourse]] online is getting too angry. "People stop listening; [[ergo]], they stop learning," she said. After the talk, the dean asked her to help write a new [[curriculum]] on media. Iryna enjoyed the [[prestige]] of the invitation, but she was happiest about the work. On the train home, Anna called her a real [[intellectual]]. "You have a great [[intellect]], Aunt Iryna!" she said. Iryna laughed. "No, I just read a lot of books."

chapters.title: Anna Has a Virus
chapters.story: Anna feels bad today, so she visits the [[doctor]]. The doctor checks her [[pulse]]. Then she uses a [[thermometer]]. It says 38 degrees! She asks Anna about her [[symptoms|symptom]]. Anna has a headache and a sore throat. "It is a [[virus]]," the doctor says. "You do not need an [[antibiotic]]. Take an [[aspirin]], 500 [[milligrams|milligram]], twice a day." The next morning, Anna feels much better. The medicine has a good [[effect]].

chapters.title: Max at the Clinic
chapters.story: Max has a busy morning at the city clinic. First, he checks in at the [[front office]]. His tooth hurts, so the dentist gives him an [[anesthetic]]. "You may need an [[implant]] one day," she says. She also tells him to use [[floss]] every night. "And wear your [[retainer]], please!" Next, a skin doctor checks his [[acne]] and gives him a cream. Finally, an eye doctor looks at his [[retina]]. "Your eyes are fine. You don't need [[laser]] surgery," she says. Max leaves the clinic tired but happy.

chapters.title: Dad's Yearly Checkup
chapters.story: Anna's dad has his yearly [[checkup]] on Monday. The doctor says his [[cholesterol]] is a little high. She asks about his [[risk factors|risk factor]], like smoking and stress. She sends him for a [[stress test]] and a cancer [[screening]]. She also wants him to see a heart [[specialist]]. "Do you still get [[migraines|migraine]]?" she asks. "Only on Mondays," Dad jokes. The clinic's [[case management]] team also helps Grandpa. They check his [[pacemaker]] and his [[insulin]]. They also look at the [[tremor]] in his hands. In the evening, Dad and Grandpa eat a healthy salad together.

chapters.title: Anna's Healthy Lifestyle
chapters.story: This year, Anna wants a healthier [[lifestyle]]. First, she stops eating [[junk food]] after classes. She buys [[vitamins|vitamin]] and fish oil with [[omega-3]]. Every morning, she puts bananas and milk in the [[blender]]. She drinks a big [[smoothie]] before class. After [[yoga]], she has a drink with [[electrolytes|electrolyte]]. On the weekend, she even tries a juice [[detox]]. In the evenings, she reads about [[metabolism]] and [[wellness]] online. At last, she shows Max a new [[anti-aging]] cream. "Anna, you are nineteen!" Max laughs. "Okay, maybe I don't need this one," Anna says with a smile.

chapters.title: Talking About Stress
chapters.story: Before her exams, Anna is under a lot of [[stress]]. Some nights she feels [[discomfort]] in her chest and cannot sleep. Max tells her to visit the college counselor, a kind woman named Olena. Olena asks Anna to write down every [[trigger]] that makes her anxious. They also talk about Anna's [[phobia]] of speaking in front of big groups. Olena teaches her simple [[coping]] skills, like slow breathing and short walks. "A calm, positive [[mindset]] really helps," she says, "and so does a little [[optimism]]." She gives Anna a [[self-help]] book and a weekly [[stress management]] plan. Asking for help is brave, she says, even with the [[stigma]] around mental health. Later that week, she gives every student a hotline number for thoughts of [[suicide]] or [[self-harm]]. Anna passes her exams, and she keeps the book on her desk.

chapters.title: Grandma Remembers Lockdown
chapters.story: On a rainy evening, Anna asks Grandma about the [[COVID]] years. "The whole city was in [[lockdown]] for weeks," Grandma says. "A virus is a kind of [[pathogen]], so we all stayed home. In winter, [[influenza]] was dangerous too. Your grandpa got [[pneumonia]] and went to the hospital. He needed [[oxygen]] and careful [[monitoring]] for five days. I stayed in [[quarantine]] at home and called him every day. Later, we both got a [[booster]] shot." Anna hugs her. "I'm glad those days are over, Grandma."

chapters.title: An Accident in the Street
chapters.story: On Monday, Anna sees a man fall off his bike. She feels a rush of [[adrenaline]] and calls for help. The [[dispatcher]] sends an ambulance right away. Two [[paramedics|paramedic]] arrive in five minutes. The man is in [[shock]] and has head [[trauma]]. They give him [[morphine]] for the pain. At the hospital, a doctor's [[pager]] beeps, and she runs to him. The man is in a [[coma]] for one day. He needs blood from a [[donor]]. His wife is in great [[distress]], so Anna stays with her. The next evening, the man wakes up and smiles at them.

chapters.title: Health Week at College
chapters.story: During health week, Dr. Kovalenko visits Anna's college to give a sex education class. She shows a clear diagram of the [[penis]] and the [[vagina]] and explains how they work. Then she explains how a [[hormone]] like testosterone can change your mood and body. Stress and poor sleep can lower your [[libido]], she says. She also explains what an [[orgasm]] is, in calm, scientific words. Next, she shows how to use a [[condom]] correctly to stay safe. She tells the students that a [[tampon]] is safe if you change it often. Infections like [[herpes]] and [[syphilis]] are common, but doctors can test for them and help. Finally, she says that [[porno]] is not real life and gives a wrong picture of love. Nobody laughs, and many students stay after class to ask questions. Max says it is the most useful class of the year.

chapters.title: Uncle Petro's Way Back
chapters.story: Anna's uncle Petro is an [[alcoholic]], and the family has worried about him for years. Last spring, after a long fight with [[alcoholism]], he finally went to [[rehab]]. He also stopped smoking, because he did not want [[nicotine]] to control him too. In his support group, people have very different stories. One woman used [[heroin]] and other [[opiates|opiate]] for ten years. A young man talks about [[cocaine]] and [[meth]] and the friends he lost. Another man started with [[marijuana]] at parties and later tried [[LSD]]. A woman explains how [[amphetamine]] pills ruined her sleep and her job. An older man takes [[methadone]] every day to stay away from street drugs. Petro listens to everyone and feels less alone. On Sunday, he comes to family dinner, drinks only tea, and Anna hugs him.

chapters.title: The Big Derby on TV
chapters.story: Max's dad is a big [[football]] [[fanatic]]. Tonight, they watch the city [[derby]] on TV together. The [[match]] is Kyiv Reds [[versus]] Kyiv Blues. In the first half, the [[referee]] calls a [[foul]] on the Reds. Later, he calls an [[offside]], and Dad shouts at the TV. In the second half, the Reds' [[goalkeeper]] saves a penalty. It is 1-1, so the game goes into [[extra time]]. In the last minute, a [[midfielder]] passes to the fast [[winger]]. He scores the winning [[goal]]! Max and his dad jump up and watch the [[replay]] five times.

chapters.title: Max at the Gym
chapters.story: Max wants to do more [[sport]] this year. He joins a [[club]] with a big [[fitness center]]. His [[trainer]], Oleh, is a [[guru]] with many online followers. Oleh makes a plan to improve Max's [[fitness]]. Max does twenty minutes of [[cardio]] and some [[stretching]]. On Fridays, he even goes to a [[pilates]] class. One day, an older man shows Max his huge [[biceps]] and [[six-pack]]. "I use [[steroids|steroid]]," he says. "Do you want some?" "No, thanks," Max says. "I want to stay healthy." After the workout, he books a long massage instead.

chapters.title: The Kyiv Marathon
chapters.story: Anna loves [[jogging]] in the park every morning. She checks her speed on her new fitness [[tracker]]. In May, she runs her first race in Kyiv. At the [[start]], she feels nervous but happy. Fast [[runners|runner]] go past her in a quick [[sprint]]. Max says some of them do [[cross-country]] and [[triathlon]] too. Anna runs slowly, but she does not stop. At the end, a [[champion]] from Lviv waves to everyone. This young [[athlete]] stands on the [[podium]]. She gets a gold [[medal]] and a big [[prize]]. Journalists ask another [[medalist]] questions about [[doping]]. Anna has no medal, but she is very proud.

chapters.title: Taras Learns Karate
chapters.story: Taras is Anna's little brother, and he starts [[karate]] this month. His [[dojo]] is near his school. His [[sensei]] has a black belt and a fifth [[dan]]. She also teaches [[kung fu]] on weekends. Every Friday, the kids do [[sparring]] in pairs. At home, Taras watches [[sumo]] on TV with Dad. One day, he meets a young [[gymnast]] from the next hall. She can do a perfect split, and Taras wants to try. Now he practices kicks and splits every day.

chapters.title: Boxing Night
chapters.story: On Saturday night, Max invites his friends over to watch sports on TV. First they see a famous [[boxer]] win easily, and then the [[MMA]] event begins. The young [[challenger]] is clearly the [[underdog]], and nobody expects him to win. The main [[fight]] starts badly for him, and he falls in the first round. But this [[fighter]] does not give up, and slowly he makes a [[comeback]]. In the third round, he hits the [[champ]] hard and wins by [[knockout]]. The [[commentator]] screams so loudly that Max's cat runs under the sofa. The fans in the hall are in total [[euphoria]], and so are Max's friends. Later, they watch the [[highlights|highlight]] again and again until midnight. Max says, "Tomorrow I'm going to the gym!"

chapters.title: Basketball After School
chapters.story: Taras plays [[basketball]] for his school team. One Monday, the coach shows the [[roster]] for the next game. Taras sees his name on it and smiles. It is a [[playoff]] game against a strong [[opponent]]. In the first half, a [[teammate]] makes a great [[dunk]]. Then Taras gets the [[rebound]] and makes an [[assist]]. The other team scores fast, so the coach calls a [[time-out]]. After that, Taras's team plays better and wins. Next week, they also win the [[final]]! It is a real [[triumph]] for the whole school. The school [[mascot]], a big blue bear, dances on the court. Both teams shake hands, because the coach loves [[fair play]].

chapters.title: A Day at the Ocean
chapters.story: Max and Anna spend their summer vacation by the [[ocean]]. On the first day, they try [[surfing]] and [[SUP]]. A friendly [[surfer]] shows them his light [[fiberglass]] [[surfboard]]. Then they rent a [[kayak]] for two hours. The next morning, they go [[diving]] with a [[diver]] named Oleh. From the water, they see a small boat near the shore. Its [[keel]] hits a [[buoy]], but nobody is hurt. Above the beach, people are [[skydiving]] with colorful parachutes. In the evening, Max and Anna play [[volleyball]] on the sand. Anna wins, and Max says she is just lucky. Tired and happy, they eat ice cream and watch the sunset.

chapters.title: Boards and Bikes
chapters.story: Taras and his friends love extreme sports and [[hip-hop]]. After school, they go [[skateboarding]] in the park. Taras rides a new [[skateboard]] from his grandma. On Saturday, they take their [[mountain bikes|mountain bike]] to the forest. The bikes have light [[composite]] frames. They ride on a long [[trail]] near the river. Taras loves [[biking]], but in winter he prefers [[snowboarding]]. His friends also play [[hockey]], [[frisbee]] and [[paintball]]. One evening, they invite Anna to join them. Anna laughs and says, "I want something calm." So everyone goes [[bowling]], and Anna wins every game!

chapters.title: An American Sports Weekend
chapters.story: In October, Max flies to Texas to visit his friend Jake. On Friday night, they watch [[baseball]] at a small local stadium. In the last [[inning]], a young player hits a [[home run]], and everyone jumps up. On Saturday, Jake takes him to an American football game at his old high school. The [[quarterback]] throws the ball far, and a big [[linebacker]] falls on the grass. Then the home team scores a [[touchdown]] and later a [[field goal]]. The [[cheerleaders|cheerleader]] dance and jump, and Max finds their [[cheerleading]] amazing. On Sunday, they go to a [[rodeo]], where cowboys ride wild horses. After that, they watch Jake's sister play [[lacrosse]] in the park. Her friends invite Max to try [[softball]], and he misses every ball. Max laughs and says that sports at home feel much easier.

chapters.title: A Day at the Golf Club
chapters.story: Max's rich uncle Victor invites him to his [[golf club]] on Sunday. Max has never played [[golf]], so he feels a little nervous. A friendly [[caddie]] carries their heavy bags across the green grass. While they walk, Uncle Victor talks about [[tennis]] and his trip to a [[grand slam]] final. He also loves [[polo]], [[rugby]] and especially [[cricket]]. He explains that in that game a [[bowler]] throws the ball at the wickets. Max tries his first shot, but the ball flies straight into the lake. Everyone laughs, including Max himself. On the way home, Max says, "Next time, let's just play [[badminton]] in the yard."

chapters.title: Max's Band
chapters.story: Max loves [[rock]], and he plays [[bass]] in a [[band]] with friends. This month, they want to try [[heavy metal]]. Every evening, they practice in Max's garage. The [[drummer]], Ihor, keeps a fast [[rhythm]]. The [[guitarist]], Sofia, tunes her [[instrument]] very carefully. Their [[frontman]], Dima, cannot find the right [[tone]] for a new song. He tries again and again, and finally it sounds great. On Sunday, they record their first [[demo]] on a phone. Max sends it to Anna, and she says it's loud but cool.

chapters.title: Concert Night
chapters.story: Anna and Max go to a [[concert]] tonight. It is at the new [[arena]] in Kyiv. All the tickets are [[sold out]]. But Max has two [[premium]] tickets! The band starts with a long [[intro]]. Then they play a [[track]] from the new [[album]]. The guitarist plays a great [[solo]]. The singer has very strong [[vocals|vocal]]. A happy [[groupie]] sings every word. Anna sees the [[tour manager]] near the stage. At the end, Max buys [[merch]] for them. Anna says, "I love a good [[live show]]!"

chapters.title: A Summer Music Festival
chapters.story: In July, Anna and Max go to a summer music [[festival]]. The [[lineup]] has something for everyone. There is [[rap]], [[R&B]], [[reggae]] and [[electro]]. First, a young [[rapper]] does a [[freestyle]] with the [[MC]]. The crowd shouts and claps to the beat. Later, a [[vocalist]] with a soft voice sings [[world music]]. Anna does not know any of the songs. But by the evening, she has five new favorites. On the way home, she plays them on her phone.

chapters.title: Jazz in a Small Club
chapters.story: On Friday, Anna's dad takes her to a small [[jazz]] club. It is warm and dark, and it smells of coffee. First, a [[trio]] plays the [[blues]]. Then a [[pianist]] plays a happy [[funk]] song. An old man plays the [[saxophone]] with his eyes closed. A young woman plays the [[bongos|bongo]] next to him. At the end, the band plays the last line in [[unison]]. The music has a great [[groove]], and Anna taps her feet. In the corner, she sees an old [[jukebox]]. Dad puts in a coin, and they dance to one more song.

chapters.title: A Night at the Opera
chapters.story: Grandma Halyna buys two tickets to the [[opera]] for Anna's birthday. Before the show, a string [[quartet]] plays a gentle [[sonata]] in the big hall. The story is about a sad [[phantom]] who lives under an old theater. A young [[soprano]] steps forward and sings a beautiful [[aria]] about love. Then a [[tenor]] answers her with a strong, warm voice. The [[maestro]] smiles and leads the whole [[ensemble]] into the final song. At the end, Anna claps so hard that her hands hurt. "Next year, I'm buying the tickets," she tells Grandma.

chapters.title: Taras's Music Lesson
chapters.story: Taras plays in the school band. Today his teacher sings two notes, [[fa]] and [[la]]. "The space between two notes is an [[interval]]," she says. Taras plays the [[trombone]], and his friend Ihor plays the [[tuba]]. A small girl plays the [[piccolo]] very high. Ihor's brother plays [[sax]] in the back. At the end, the teacher hits a big [[gong]]. Everyone laughs, and the lesson is over.

chapters.title: Dance Lessons
chapters.story: Anna and Max take dance lessons before cousin Olya's wedding. On Monday, they learn the [[tango]]. Max steps on Anna's foot twice. On Wednesday, they dance [[salsa]] and then [[samba]]. "We can dance this at the [[carnival]] in February!" says Anna. On Friday, the teacher shows them a fast [[polka]]. Max likes the [[boogie]] best. After class, they watch a [[ballet]] on TV. "A [[ballerina]] never steps on feet," Anna jokes. At the wedding, they dance the [[mambo]] all night, and nobody falls.

chapters.title: Dad's Old Records
chapters.story: On Sunday, Anna's dad opens an old box. Inside, there are old records on [[vinyl]] and some [[CDs|CD]]. He plays them on his big [[stereo]]. First, they listen to [[rock and roll]], then loud [[hard rock]]. "At school, I loved [[punk]] and [[new wave]]," Dad says. "I was a real [[rocker]] with long hair." He even played guitar in a [[rock band]]. Grandpa was a [[hippie]], and he played the [[banjo]]. "Now there is a [[revival]] of our music," Dad says happily. "It was a great [[era]]." Anna puts on Dad's [[retro]] jacket and asks, "Can I keep it?"

chapters.title: Max's First Rave
chapters.story: On Saturday night, Max goes to his first [[rave]] in an old factory. It is a [[mega]] party with hundreds of people and colorful lights. The DJ plays a long [[mix]] that starts with fast [[techno]]. Then the music turns into old [[acid house]], and everyone jumps. Next to Max, a quiet [[goth]] in black clothes plays a [[synth]] on a small stage. At sunrise, a band plays loud [[punk rock]], and Max dances until his legs hurt. In the morning, he texts Anna: "I need to sleep for two days!"

chapters.title: Sofia Writes a Song
chapters.story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[songwriter]] who writes songs in her small room. She loves [[folk]], but she also listens to calm [[new age]] music. One day, a [[producer]] hears her songs and invites her to his studio. With her friend Oleh, she records a [[duet]] about the rain. He adds a long [[instrumental]] in the middle of the song. Later, a DJ makes a [[remix]], and it sounds great at parties. They plan the [[release]] of her [[debut]] album for May. The [[title track]] is a song about Kyiv at night. When the album comes out, the whole family listens to it together.

chapters.title: The School Play
chapters.story: Taras gets a big [[role]] in the school play. The show is at the city [[theater]] on Friday. The play is a [[drama]] about a lost kingdom. Taras plays a young [[prince]]. He is the [[protagonist]], so he has many lines. In the second act, he says a long [[monologue]]. In the next scene, a [[poet]] reads a [[sonnet]] at a [[masquerade]]. Before they start, every [[actor]] is nervous, but Taras is calm. Their teacher knows the whole school [[repertoire]] by heart. After the show, she says, "Taras, you have real [[talent]]!"

chapters.title: A Weekend of Comedy
chapters.story: On Friday, Anna and her friends start their comedy weekend with an [[improv]] show. After that, they see a short [[stand-up]] set by a nervous young comedian. On Saturday, they go to a [[cabaret]], where a [[drag queen]] welcomes everyone. The evening ends with a [[revue]] of songs from a famous [[musical]]. On Sunday, they buy cheap tickets for the [[matinee]] and laugh at a comedy [[duo]]. One joke about cats is a total [[fail]], but the two comedians laugh at it too. In the evening, they go to a charity [[gala]] at the city theater. There, an old [[artiste]] with great [[humor]] sings and tells funny stories. The last act is a short [[farce]] about two lost brothers. At midnight, Max says, "My face hurts from laughing!"

chapters.title: A Day at the Museum
chapters.story: On Saturday, Anna takes Max to the [[art]] museum. First, they visit the [[Renaissance|renaissance]] room. Max likes a [[portrait]] of a young man in a red hat. Anna likes a painting of the [[Madonna|madonna]] with a baby. The guide says it is full of [[symbolism]]. Next, Anna looks at the [[contour]] of a face in a drawing. Then they see statues by a famous [[sculptor]]. Each statue stands on a stone [[pedestal]]. Max wants to sit on a chair, but it is an [[antique]]! Upstairs, there are modern paintings in the style of [[realism]]. A [[critic]] writes notes in front of a big painting of Kyiv. The [[curator]] explains the strong [[contrast]] of dark and light colors.

chapters.title: Street Art in Kyiv
chapters.story: Max shows Anna an old district of Kyiv. Every wall near the station has [[graffiti]] on it. On one house, there is a huge [[mural]] of a big bird. "The city pays for this [[public art]]," Max says. The bird covers the whole [[exterior]] in [[indigo]] and white. Next, they go into an [[art space]] in an old factory. It shows [[contemporary art]] by young artists. One room is full of [[avant-garde]] pictures. Anna buys a [[poster]] by a local [[illustrator]]. An [[art critic]] talks about [[design]] with a young [[designer]]. She shows him a bright [[visual]] for a concert. At home, Anna puts her new picture on the wall.

chapters.title: What Shall We Watch?
chapters.story: On Friday evening, Anna and Max want to watch a [[film]]. They open their [[streaming service]], but they cannot choose. First, they watch three [[trailers|trailer]]. Anna checks the [[rating]] of each movie. They argue about the [[genre]]. Anna wants a [[thriller]], but Max wants [[sci-fi]]. His movie is about a [[cyborg]] who saves a city. "What about [[fantasy]]?" Anna asks. Then Max gives a [[spoiler]] about the [[sequel]] of a summer [[blockbuster]]. Anna throws a pillow at him, and they watch a comedy.

chapters.title: Thursday Night TV
chapters.story: On Thursdays at [[prime time]], the family watches TV together. But everyone wants a different [[show]]. Max wants a new [[episode]] of his favorite [[sitcom]]. Grandma prefers a [[game show]] with big prizes. Taras loves a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Mom wants a [[talk show]] with a funny [[gag]] about a cat. Its next [[segment]] is about healthy food. Max sighs and says, "[[Streaming|streaming]] is better [[entertainment]]!" He goes to his room with his laptop. He sends Anna a [[promo]] for a new [[spin-off]]. Then he sends her a short [[clip]], and she laughs.

chapters.title: A Day on Set
chapters.story: Sofia went to a [[casting]] and got a small role as an extra. On her first day, she met the young [[filmmaker]] and the [[production designer]]. The [[cameraman]] asked her to stand still for a [[close-up]] of her face. Between scenes, the [[narrator]] explained the [[setting]]: a small town in the 1960s. Sofia's scene was a [[flashback]] to the main character's childhood. In the evening, the director showed the team a short [[preview]]. The [[footage]] was full of [[suspense]], and the [[soundtrack]] was beautiful. Then Sofia laughed: the director had a tiny [[cameo]] as a bus driver beside her.

chapters.title: Grandpa's Old Films
chapters.story: On Sunday, Grandpa told Anna about the old [[drive-in]] near his village. Before that, he and Grandma often went to shows at the [[music hall]] downtown. His favorite movies are classic [[noir]], but Grandma always loved a good [[melodrama]]. "I never liked the [[mainstream]]," Grandpa said. "I prefer [[indie]]." He put a [[disc]] into the old player, and they watched a [[remake]] of a detective movie. "It's a nice [[homage]] to the original," he said. Later, Anna found an old [[photo album]] and a box of [[negatives|negative]]. She scanned them and made a [[slide show]] for the whole family. When Grandpa saw it, his eyes were full of [[nostalgia]].

chapters.title: Taras's Anime Heroes
chapters.story: Taras watches [[anime]] every night after dinner. His favorite hero is a shy boy at school. But his [[alter ego]] is strong and fast, like a [[superman]]. His only weakness is cold water. It is his [[kryptonite]]. The villain is a cold [[sociopath]] with many [[minions|minion]]. He also has a [[droid]] and an angry [[ogre]]. They all live in a [[creepy]] castle with an old [[vampire]]. The vampire is funny, and the ogre is not a [[cannibal]]. He only eats soup! Before bed, Taras reads a book about a [[hobbit]]. It is a long [[saga]], and he loves every page. Tonight he falls asleep with the book on his face.

chapters.title: Taras the Gamer
chapters.story: Taras is a real [[gamer]]. [[Gaming|gaming]] is his favorite hobby. On Saturday, he turns on his [[console]] and takes his new [[controller]]. He joins his online [[squad]]. Soon he finds a rare [[item]] and makes a ten-hit [[combo]]. Then the screen freezes. "[[Lag|lag]] again!" he shouts. Dad checks the router and finds a problem with the [[IP]] address. The game restarts, and Taras loses his new [[high score]]. Dad smiles. "Next time, buy faster internet, not a new [[add-on]]."

chapters.title: Max Makes a Game
chapters.story: Max and his friend Oleh dream of becoming [[game developers|game developer]]. This year, they finally start their own small project. Max's cousin Ira joins as [[project manager]], and a classmate joins as one more [[dev]]. Together they make an [[RPG]] about a magic forest. The hero is a brave [[elf]] who fights an [[orc]] and a sneaky [[goblin]]. On the way, she meets an old [[mage]] who has no [[mana]] left. The [[gameplay]] is simple, but their friends love it. Players can even add a [[mod]] and choose their own [[avatar]]. After a month, a hundred people download the game, and Ira orders pizza for everyone.

chapters.title: Uncle's Poker Night
chapters.story: Max's uncle Petro invites his friends for a [[poker]] night. They play with plastic chips and a big bowl of peanuts. Uncle Petro tries a big [[bluff]] and goes [[all-in]]. But his neighbor calmly shows a [[full house]]. "You're a real [[hustler]]!" Uncle Petro laughs and hands over all his chips. Then he tells long stories about a [[casino]] trip many years ago. He played [[blackjack]] all night and lost everything. "[[Gambling|gambling]] is not for me anymore," he says. "I never won a [[jackpot]], not once." Grandma shakes her head. "You're a [[gambler]], Petro. Play [[pinball]] instead!"

chapters.title: Anna's Travel Blog
chapters.story: Anna starts a travel [[blog]] on the [[web]]. First, she writes a short [[bio]] about herself. Her first [[post]] is about a weekend in Lviv. She adds a [[hashtag]], a sun [[emoji]] and a funny [[gif]]. Max lends her his [[tripod]], and she films a short [[video clip]]. She works on her [[content]] every evening. She answers every [[comment]], even the short ones. After two months, [[blogging]] brings her a hundred [[followers|follower]]. Max smiles. "Now you're a real [[blogger]]!"

chapters.title: Max's Cat Goes Viral
chapters.story: Max films a funny [[video]] of his cat, Bublyk. He drags the clip onto the [[timeline]] and adds music. The next day, it is a [[meme]]. Soon it is a [[trend]] in the whole city. People add a [[tag]] with the cat's name. His classmate writes a [[tweet]] about it. The [[hype]] grows every day. A pet shop offers a [[giveaway]] for his fans. Then Max posts a [[how-to]] about a kitchen [[hack]] for cat owners. He also makes a [[playlist]] of songs for cat lovers. Bublyk does not care. He just sleeps on the keyboard.

chapters.title: Trouble in the Comments
chapters.story: One evening, a [[troll]] wrote rude comments under Anna's post about Kyiv. Then he sent her a friend [[request]], which was very strange. Anna wrote to the [[moderator]] of the travel [[forum]]. She quickly stopped the [[trolling]] and deleted all the [[hate speech]]. The whole online [[community]] supported Anna. Then the rude user said that the Kyiv metro was closed for a year. People asked him for [[proof]] and real [[info]]. Of course, he had none, because it was just [[fake news]]. He disappeared that night, and Anna went back to planning her next trip.

chapters.title: Anna's Podcast
chapters.story: Anna and Max start a [[podcast]] about student life in Kyiv. Max writes a short, happy [[jingle]] for the start. They record the [[audio]] on an old [[recorder]]. In the evening, Anna edits the [[audio file]] on her laptop. They also print a small [[booklet]] about the show. Every week they practice [[storytelling]] with funny stories from class. One day, a [[reporter]] from a local [[radio]] station calls them. She wants an [[interview]] with them on her [[radio show]]. Max is nervous, but Anna says, "Just tell a good story!"

chapters.title: Meeting a Superstar
chapters.story: Sofia is a [[finalist]] in a TV [[talent show]]. After her song, a talent [[scout]] from [[showbiz]] gives her a card. Backstage, she meets a famous [[superstar]]. He is a rich [[playboy]] with a big [[bodyguard]]. [[VIP]] guests talk about [[glamour]] and fast cars. Outside, the [[paparazzi]] take hundreds of photos. Then girls from her school [[fan club]] run to Sofia. They ask for her [[autograph]], not his!

chapters.title: A Day at the Zoo
chapters.story: On Saturday, Anna takes her little brother Taras to the zoo. First, they see a big [[tiger]] and a quiet [[gorilla]]. A mother [[orangutan]] holds her baby. The [[panda]] eats bamboo, and a [[zebra]] runs in the sun. A [[leopard]] sleeps on a high branch. In the river, a [[crocodile]] opens its huge mouth. Taras hides behind Anna when he sees the [[python]]. Next, they watch pink [[flamingos|flamingo]] and funny [[lemurs|lemur]]. A guide explains each animal's natural [[habitat]]. At the end, they are very hungry. They buy hot dogs at the [[snack bar]].

chapters.title: Dogs at the Picnic
chapters.story: On Sunday, Anna's family has a [[picnic]] in the park. They sit at a table in the old [[pavilion]]. Soon a funny [[bulldog]] comes and looks at their sandwiches. Then a [[beagle]] and a sleepy [[basset]] follow it. Max arrives with his [[husky]] and his aunt's [[collie]]. A friendly [[pit bull]] plays with a ball near the trees. Max's aunt's dog moves the others together by [[instinct]], like sheep. A vet tells them about a [[parasite]] from dirty pond water. So Anna's dad fills a clean bowl for the dogs. Before they go home, Max cleans up his dog's [[excrement]]. Everyone says the park looks nicer than before.

chapters.title: Grandma's Farm
chapters.story: Anna and Max spend Saturday on Grandma's farm. The [[farmer]] next door waves to them from his field. He drives his big [[tractor]] over forty [[hectares|hectare]] of wheat. Grandma's old [[mule]] is slow, but very strong. It carries ten [[bushels|bushel]] of apples from the [[homestead]] to the road. Behind the house, bees collect [[nectar]] from the flowers. Grandma never uses a [[pesticide]] in her garden. 'Bees are my friends,' she says. Her new tree is a [[hybrid]] of a pear and an apple. 'I want to taste the first fruit!' says Max.

chapters.title: Hiking in the Carpathians
chapters.story: In July, Anna and Max go [[hiking]] in the Carpathian Mountains. They stay at a small [[camp]] near a high [[cliff]]. Max uses a [[compass]] to find the path to the [[peak]]. On the way, a cool [[breeze]] comes up from the [[canyon]]. They rest under an old [[cedar]] on big [[granite]] rocks. Higher up, they walk across a wide, green [[plateau]]. Anna takes photos of the local [[flora]]: flowers, moss and berries. Then they paddle a [[canoe]] across a quiet mountain lake. On the shore, Max finds a shiny piece of [[quartz]]. Near the lake, they meet boy scouts who love [[scouting]]. Together they climb a hill and see a [[panorama]] of the mountains. Anna smiles, 'Let's come back next summer!'

chapters.title: Rangers and Wild Animals
chapters.story: In August, Anna and Max visit Max's cousin, a park [[ranger]] in America. On the first morning, he shows them a [[grizzly]] fishing in a cold river. That night, a [[coyote]] howls somewhere near their cabin. In the morning, a [[raccoon]] is digging through their trash can. Later, they drive slowly while a herd of [[bison]] crosses the road. Max laughs at a small [[gopher]] that pops out of a hole in the grass. Then they fly north to Alaska and watch [[caribou]] walk across the tundra. In Nevada, a group of wild [[mustangs|mustang]] runs across the dry plains. Their last stop is a swamp in Florida, where an [[alligator]] lies in the sun. Every evening, Max's cousin warns them to stay on the trail because of [[cougars|cougar]]. On the last night, he makes a fire from [[hickory]] wood, and they roast corn. Anna says it was the best trip of her life.

chapters.title: A Voyage at Sea
chapters.story: Anna's uncle Petro invites her on a two-week [[voyage]] on his small research ship. Before they leave the river port, an old fisherman shows them a huge [[carp]]. Out at sea, Anna stands on the deck and watches the water all day. Suddenly, an [[orca]] jumps out of the waves right next to the ship! A man on a fishing boat waves and holds up a giant [[marlin]]. That evening, the cook grills fresh [[mackerel]] for everyone on board. In the morning, a [[pelican]] dives and catches a fish in its big beak. For hours, a white [[albatross]] flies quietly above the ship. On the last day, a diver named Olha takes Anna to see living [[coral]]. The [[reef]] is full of colors, and the water is full of tiny [[plankton]]. Through a magnifying glass, Olha shows her a little [[hydra]]. That night, Anna writes in her diary: 'The sea is a whole world.'

chapters.title: Anna's Climate Strike
chapters.story: On Friday, Anna joins a [[climate]] [[strike]] with other students in the park. Max's sign says, 'I want to see the sky, not [[smog]]!' A girl named Sofia talks about the [[ozone]] layer and why we need it. Another student shows a photo of a melting [[iceberg]] in the Arctic. A teacher explains that cows on big farms produce a lot of [[methane]]. Cars and factories also send carbon [[dioxide]] into the air. Some students ask questions about [[fracking]] and the water under the ground. Anna shares simple [[eco]] ideas, like bikes and reusable bags. A boy says a [[tornado]] once damaged his grandma's house. Sofia adds that one [[tsunami]] can hit towns along a whole coast. 'Bad weather can hurt a whole [[region]] at once,' she says. In the end, the group cleans the park together and plants three small trees.

chapters.title: At the Natural History Museum
chapters.story: On Tuesday, Anna's little brother Taras visits the natural history museum with his class. First, they see a huge [[dinosaur]] and a [[dodo]], a bird that couldn't fly. In the next hall, Taras's favorite [[primate]] is the [[gibbon]], with its long arms. In a glass case, they see a stone [[artifact]] and a [[fragment]] of mammoth bone. The guide says every living [[organism]] needs food, water and a home. In a warm tank, a [[chameleon]] slowly changes its color from green to brown. Taras finds a silk [[cocoon]] hanging on a small branch. Behind glass, [[termites|termite]] build a mud tower and follow a [[pheromone]] to find food. One room shows the [[fauna]] of Ukraine, from wolves to storks. In the last hall, a model volcano shows red [[magma]] rising from deep underground. On the bus home, Taras says he wants to be a scientist.

chapters.title: A Weekend in Paris
chapters.story: On their weekend in Paris, Anna and Mama find a small [[bistro]]. The waiter says, 'Bonjour, [[monsieur]],' to an old man. Then he smiles at Mama: 'Good afternoon, [[madame]].' 'And for you, [[mademoiselle]]?' he asks Anna. Anna orders [[madeleines|madeleine]] and [[creme]] brulee, and Mama orders [[brie]]. After lunch, Anna buys a red [[beret]] for twenty [[euros|euro]]. On Sunday, they take a train to an old [[chateau]]. Its stone [[facade]] is white and beautiful. In the evening, they dress up [[a la]] old movie stars. At dinner, a man at the next table drinks [[cognac]]. Mama has a glass of [[pinot noir]], and Anna has juice. 'Merci, Paris!' Anna laughs.

chapters.title: Summer Cruise
chapters.story: This summer, Max and his parents go on a [[cruise]]. Their [[liner]] is as big as a small town. In Venice, they take a [[gondola]] along a narrow [[canal]]. Then they drink coffee in a sunny [[piazza]]. Max takes photos of an old [[villa]] and a pink [[palace]]. A few days later, the ship stops in Spain. They walk along the [[promenade]] by the sea. Max buys a small guitar as a [[souvenir]] for Anna. In the evening, the whole town dances at a [[fiesta]]. Later, his parents sit in a [[wine bar]] and order [[chardonnay]]. A man at the next table hears them speak Ukrainian. He is a [[compatriot]] from Kyiv, and he lives near their street!

chapters.title: Rainy Days in London
chapters.story: Anna is taking a summer course in London. On the first day, it rains, and she gets very wet. Her teacher says, 'In London, you need a [[trench coat]].' On Saturday, Anna buys a cheap [[poncho]] and a warm [[jumper]]. She also gets a soft [[fleece]] and a long [[shawl]] for Mama. She pays in [[sterling]] and counts the coins slowly. She eats a [[scone]] with jam and buys [[toffee]] for Max. Later, she visits a small art museum. One old painting there once cost a hundred [[guineas|guinea]]. When Anna gets lost in the rain, a kind [[constable]] helps her. She is wet, but happy.

chapters.title: Max's Train Trip North
chapters.story: This summer, Max travels across Europe by train with one backpack. In Berlin, his hosts, [[Herr]] and [[Frau]] Weber, take him to a summer music [[fest]]. In the Alps, the nights are cold, so Max buys a warm [[cardigan]]. He sleeps in a wooden [[chalet]] below the castle of an old [[baron]]. When he shouts 'Hello!' from the hill, he hears a long [[echo]]. A local guide explains that every Swiss [[canton]] has its own flag. Everything is expensive, and his [[francs|franc]] disappear very fast. In Norway, he pays in [[krone]] and takes a boat along a deep [[fjord]]. In a museum in Oslo, he sees an old [[Viking]] ship. His last stop is Iceland, where a [[geyser]] shoots hot water high into the air. Max sends Anna a photo: 'Next year, you are coming with me!'

chapters.title: Greek Letters in Athens
chapters.story: Anna spends a week in Athens with her friend Max. The street signs are in Greek, so she can't read them. Max buys her a little book about Greek letters.
